'''Flossin Noz''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who lived on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and was the zealot [[Chief/Legends|chief]] of a violent religious group called the [[Muskegs]]. Operating out of a [[Muskeg Reactionaries Camp]] a short distance east of the [[Gungan Sacred Place/Legends|Gungan Sacred Place]], he was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] dispatched by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Rugor Nass]] to recover an artifact that had been stolen from him by the Muskegs.<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Flossin Noz appeared as a non-player character in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:RtGAsbtM" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Flossin Noz was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
